title: Visit BUZZY | Cobble Hill Cannabis Dispensary, Brooklyn
description: Visit BUZZY at 137 Court St in Cobble Hill, Brooklyn — shop curated cannabis in store, or order ahead online for pickup.

blocks.html: A Brooklyn dispensary in Cobble Hill offering curated cannabis and trusted, welcoming service.

items.title: Public Transit
items.html:
Subway: Take the 2, 3, 4, 5, R, or F train to Borough Hall / Court Street Station. Our dispensary is just a short walk away.

Bus: Multiple MTA bus routes stop within a block of our location.

items.title: Driving
items.html: Street parking and nearby garages are available. For the easiest route, get directions to our Cobble Hill Brooklyn dispensary on Google Maps.

items.title: Accessibility
items.html: Our Brooklyn dispensary is wheelchair accessible, with wide entryways and ADA-compliant restrooms to ensure a comfortable visit for all guests.

items.q: Can I order online for pickup?
items.a_html: Yes! You can shop online, reserve your cannabis products, and pick them up at our Brooklyn dispensary during pickup hours. View our Menu.
Yes. All NYC dispensaries, including ours, require a valid government-issued ID to prove you are 21 or older.

items.q: Can I pay with a credit card at a dispensary in NYC?
items.a_html: Most dispensaries accept debit cards and cash. Some locations also accept mobile payments. ATMs are usually available on-site.

sections.heading: Cannabis dispensary in Cobble Hill Brooklyn

blocks.html: Wander the 22 landmarked blocks of the Cobble Hill Historic District and enjoy one of Brooklyn’s most charming neighborhoods — where historic brownstones meet modern convenience. Relax in nearby Cobble Hill Park or stroll to Brooklyn Bridge Park for stunning waterfront views.

Explore the vibrant stretch of Court Street, known for boutique shopping and some of the best restaurants in Brooklyn — from family-run bakeries and Italian markets to coffee shops, bars, and neighborhood staples just around the corner.

Whether you’re a local or visiting, Buzzy is your go-to destination for cannabis, marijuana, and weed in Cobble Hill, Brooklyn. Stop by our neighborhood dispensary and discover thoughtfully curated products in a welcoming space.
